question: Which native Settlers production filters are shared by the human unit menu, AI candidate generation and ordinary completion, and what remains before a human and AI construction prohibition?

scope.boundary: Four exact generated functions and native-only AI caller and CityUpdate windows within the inspected scope were inspected. The native-only CityUpdate windows use its accepted generated mapping despite the eight-byte canonical Ghidra function listing. No AI evaluator, command producer or writer, creation helper, save or restore thunk or post-list indirect target body was opened. The result identifies local acceptance and completion checks that still depend on conditions that are not established, not complete return, execution, a universal construction ban or a patch.

dependencies.use: Supplies definition 0 Settlers, definition 1 FSettler, definition stride 0x94 and accepted AI evaluator identities.
Supplies signed city population byte+3 and city record context.
Ties human production parent call 0x82E017F4 to the unit wrapper and the child option-vector path.
Separates human selected-item submission from list eligibility.
Reuses the seven generator callers, AI mode-1 inputs and generator-to-command helper context; the caller census was reconfirmed with no new sites.
Supplies owner-matched current-item assignment at city+0x38; it supplies no global Settler prohibition.
Reuses ordinary technology query sentinel and zero-input meanings.
Supplies cumulative UEA lookup 0x82CF0CB0 and its player and era inputs; UEA 45 meaning is not assigned.
Supplies ordinary unit-cost composition and completion invested-production comparison.
Supplies accepted CityUpdate identity, native creation context and Ghidra listing boundary.
Preserves the separate all-owned-city reward and shared population-helper and mask boundaries without reopening them.
Accepted setup chain and unresolved new-game-only entry point.
Closed registration and dispatch search and exact reopening discriminator.
Accepted namespaced manual-slot identity, pre-load and finalized-save hook points.
Accepted post-setup recount and separate serializer and load-function locators.

definitionInputs.qualification: These are supported-image definition values, not proof of preserved live definition memory. FSettler is a separate ID; no alias or equivalence between grant and construction is inferred.

humanPath.source: The accepted production parent calls 0x82CED7E8 at 0x82E017F4 with city index and the unit-array destination. The wrapper passes r3 = the preserved city index and r4=1 to 0x82CEBC38 at 0x82CED86C.
humanPath.wrapper: 0x82CED80C..0x82CED838 returns zero on city+0x24 bit 0x400 set together with signed current item+0x38>=200. Otherwise it sets U32[0x8314F1DC]=1, requests a 400-byte -1 fill of scratch 0x8312D7B0 through 0x827F7BB0, and invokes the generator. On required normal return it skips leading negative entries, requests a copy of (100-skipped)*4 bytes through 0x827F8550, clears the mode word and returns count-skipped. These helper effects, valid count and copy ranges, preserved fields and matching save27/restore27 return remain premises; the full wrapper return is not proved.
humanPath.mode: The generator saves incoming mode at frame+0x19C. Unit enumeration at 0x82CEC644..0x82CEC654 requires mode bit 0; mode 1 enters it and skips building mode bit 1. Live signed unit count U32[0x830E45D0] must be positive to visit index 0. Its stored-image word is zero; neither that zero nor the accepted 29 definitions fixes the live initialized count.

sharedCandidateGate.entry: 0x82CEBC4C computes city offset 188*i from incoming r3=i; base is 0x8314FE28. Signed owner is cached and also reloaded at selected checks. Valid city and player indices, completed preamble, valid map arithmetic and preserved frames and tables are required. The common city+0x24 bit 0x400/current-item>=200 early return also occurs at 0x82CEBC60..0x82CEBC8C.
sharedCandidateGate.technology: In 0x82CEC67C..0x82CEC6F0, signed definition halfword+0x4A requires ordinary ownership query 0x82CEF6A8 to return nonzero unless -1; +0x4C and +0x4E require zero unless -1. For Settlers with preserved values [-1,0,0], the first call is skipped and the other two call with r3=0 at 0x82CEC6C0/0x82CEC6E8. The exact helper zero-input arm at 0x82CEF6DC..0x82CEF6F8 returns 0 with explicit r31/LR/frame restoration and no descendant call. Its -1 arm returns 1. Other technology IDs have a separate unexpanded condition and helper path; it is not required for preserved type 0 and type 1 sentinel data.
sharedCandidateGate.flags: The generic loop tests definition+0x50 bits 0x2, 0x4000, 1 and 0x20000 at 0x82CEC6F4..0x82CEC7BC, plus a separate type 6 case. Settlers flags 1 bypass the bit 0x2 city-bit 1, bit 0x4000 excluded-owner and bit 0x20000 rejection branches; type 0 bypasses type 6. Only its flag 1 population threshold remains active after the sentinel returns. Definition fields are reloaded and must retain their declared values across calls.
sharedCandidateGate.threshold: At 0x82CEC764..0x82CEC76C call 0x82CF0CB0(45,signed current owner,0). Let U be its result. If U!=0, T=2. Otherwise 0x82CEC778..0x82CEC794 reads signed W=U32[0x830ED3D8+4*owner]; T=2 if W==5, otherwise T=3. 0x82CEC7A8/0x82CEC7AC requires signed population city+3>=T. UEA 45 and W preserve neutral meanings. Each selected owner load, actual U and W and population, and their preservation are inputs, not observed values.
sharedCandidateGate.append: A failed local check branches to type increment 0x82CEC838, bypassing emission. After success, 0x82CEC7C0..0x82CEC820 calls identity lookup 0x82CEF160, cost scalar 0x82CF1148 and formatter 0x82E6A3E0 before storing type 0 to the scratch array at 0x82CEC828. No returned-value comparison from those three calls controls that store, but their normal returns, array, index and count preservation and valid storage are required. Prefix counts and signed live count govern the position and iteration; no unit-loop capacity guard is visible. This emission still depends on conditions that are not established; it is not preserved final menu content.
sharedCandidateGate.fSettler: For definition 1 with preserved values [0,-1,-1], its first ownership query receives 0 and returns 0, so the prerequisite check rejects FSettler before append. Its flags 1 do not make it an alternate admissible Settlers entry. Other assignment or grant paths are not excluded.

aiPath.callers: The three accepted AITurnUnitEvaluation 0x82CB6E48 calls are word-confirmed at 0x82CB9FEC, 0x82CBA098,0x82CBA1C8. Immediate r4=-1 is set at 0x82CB9FE0,0x82CBA090,0x82CBA1C0; city r3 is copied from current r20 or r28. Valid current city identity and enclosing guards are not yet established. Mode-1 has bit 0 set and therefore uses the same inlined unit filters, including the type 0 population threshold, when it reaches this loop.
aiPath.evaluator: On the generator alternative at 0x82CECBA4..0x82CECBB4, it calls accepted AIUnitChoiceEvaluate 0x82CB44E0 with r3=city index, r4=scratch0x8312D7B0, r5=negative-prefix count and r6=total count. This consumer of the generated array still depends on conditions that are not established. The evaluator body, returned ordinal range, selected type 0 identity and subsequent command delivery were not proved.
aiPath.postListBoundary: After enumeration, the generator has current session-child vtable+0x100 dispatches beginning at 0x82CECA7C, plus human-mask and mode-word tests, then chooser or evaluator and command helper calls. Current receiver and target, outputs, array, frame and lifetime preservation, and normal return remain unresolved. Reuse existing session publication facts that still depend on conditions that are not established, without presuming the installed target or redoing their closed searches. Shared candidate filters do not establish every AI production path or a complete ban.

completionGate.inputBinding: Native 0x82D13988..0x82D13A4C ties i=r23, B=0x8314FE28=r14, city offset 188*i=r31 and definition base 0x82F700D8=r30. Frame+0x74=B, +0x8C=B+3 and +0xA4=0x830ED3D8. Incoming mode 1 directly branches at 0x82D13A50 to 0x82D159A4, bypassing the later human-classifier path; completed save14/frame setup and valid preserved inputs are required. Other entry routes can have intervening effects and require their own preserved link.
completionGate.itemAndCost: 0x82D159A8..0x82D159C4 loads signed current item+0x38, skips -1 and selects the unit path for items<100 within the supported domain. For type 0, 0x82D159C8 calls the accepted scalar; 0x82D159DC..0x82D159FC compares signed invested production+0x36 with trunc0(signed definition+0x44 * scalar /2) and branches to 0x82D16388 while insufficient. Helper return and preservation of used state remain required.
completionGate.population: 0x82D15A1C..0x82D15A28 tests definition flag 1. For Settlers it calls cumulative UEA45(owner,0) at 0x82D15A40. At 0x82D15A44..0x82D15A80 it sets K=1 for nonzero UEA result or the preserved frame+0xA4 owner word==5, otherwise K=2, then branches to 0x82D16388 when signed city+3<=K. Thus its local requirement population>K is the same threshold 2 or 3 as candidate generation. This guard precedes unit creation and is independent of a menu omission; no additional human or AI predicate occurs in this selected cost and population window.
completionGate.creation: Only after those local checks, 0x82D15A84..0x82D15AB0 loads signed owner and signed city coordinates+0x30/+0x32 and calls 0x82D11750(owner,currentItem,x,y). A -1 return branches away at 0x82D15ABC. Creation effects, other returns, later population and queue writes, caller and frame preservation, and complete construction or persistence, are not yet established. The shared helper also serves grants, so this entry is not automatically a construction-only prohibition point.
completionGate.populationClampQualification: The selected entry prefix also locally clamps signed city+3>=32 to 31 at 0x82D139D4..0x82D139E4. This is the production updater entry, not proof that the separate reward helper 0x82D00C78 executes that clamp or returns with population preserved.

integrationBoundary: The selected native human and AI candidate filters and ordinary CityUpdate cost and population checks are separate from an OCC implementation. city-militia-scout-feasibility.json#/occAiFoundingBoundary defines the current inspected title policy and the selected autonomous AI expansion route that bypasses Settler production. The accepted type-five submission and owner-matched city+0x38 assignment remains a separate enforcement surface; hiding a list entry alone does not reject an existing queue, direct assignment or another producer. Existing Settlers, other grants, captured cities and broader one-city semantics remain outside a universal construction-ban or founding-ban claim.

currentEvidence.method: Three serialized foreground tools/run-headless.ps1 -ReadOnly queries reconfirmed the accepted raw caller census and checked 1480 selected words followed only by 119 newly required CityUpdate prefix words. All 1599 words match the supported image. Capstone 5.0.7 PPC64 big-endian decoding matches 1219 generated instruction comments after numeric and spacing, exact rotate-mask shift, zero-shift identity, or.-to-mr. and TO5/TO6 trap alias normalization, and decodes 365 native-only instructions. The 6 words 0x82D13AD0..0x82D13AE4 are inline dispatch data, not instructions; 9 other words cover definitions and count. Exact own and next headers and precise spans and requests guard the four generated bodies; PC resets at loc_ labels. No next generated body or adjacent caller function was read.
currentEvidence.titleQualification: Generated0x82CF0CB0 contains an ApplyUniqueEraAbilityCell host insertion before its compare. The native image supplies the base lookup and checks recorded here; this static result does not establish any executing title rule, hook effect, effective runtime UEA 45 result or parity between native and title.
currentEvidence.generatedIdentityQualification: The title revision identifies the checkout observed when selecting the evidence. Generated artifacts are independently pinned by their whole-file digests; the revision does not assert tracked generated-file blobs or an executing runtime identity.

guards: Static local filters and checks do not prove natural execution, total normal return, preserved array, current-item or created-unit identity or an implemented construction prohibition.

Use supported valid city, player and type indices and preserved definition and count, actual population, UEA 45 and owner-word values, valid disjoint frames and normally returning required calls. No ABI or unexpanded save, restore or dispatch effect is presumed.

Do not equate Settlers 0 and FSettler 1, name UEA 45 or owner word 0x830ED3D8 from this test, treat population or cost tuning as disabling production, or infer global human and AI parity from three callers.
Do not turn the stored-image count 0 into a live no-units state or the production entry clamp into a proved reward-helper cap.
Do not suppress the shared unit creation helper globally: construction, starting units, village and milestone grants and other unit creation callers are separate.
conclusion: Settlers 0 with preserved definition values passes its sentinel technology filters and is locally accepted when population>=3, or >=2 under UEA 45 or the owner-word 5 condition. Identified human mode 1 and AI mode-1 callers share this candidate loop; FSettler 1 fails its first zero-input prerequisite. Ordinary unit completion independently checks production cost and the equivalent population threshold before calling unit creation. These are concrete human and AI construction-related checks, not proof that a list-only change enforces OCC or that the whole creation and queue path returns and preserves state.
nextDiscriminator: launchLoadoutBoundary defines the selected immutable launch-policy and two-callback contract; aiSelectionContract defines the preserved nonempty-range or pre-read no-choice protection. Implement and inspect those actual hooks and shared reads, and validate AI turn continuation. Automatic game or save identity is not required under this loadout contract; fixedPolicyBindingBoundary/gameLifecycleOwnerBoundary remains optional evidence with its original target, mode and identity guards and closed searches. Reward-mask, child returns and creation and grants remain separate.

assignmentAndQueueBoundary.question: How does a selected Settlers 0 become current production for the identified human and AI paths, what happens to an existing current item 0, and does an unattainable population requirement alone remove it?

scope.boundary: Five exact generated bodies and native-only evaluator, dispatcher and city-update windows within the inspected scope were inspected. Native-only functions have no following physical generated header in their chunks, so their generated bodies were not read. Required helper, thunk, indirect-target and transport returns still depend on conditions that are not established. Existing production here means the one current-item field+0x38; the command ring is a different queue. No multi-item city production queue, save-load policy, runtime execution, patch or implementation is established.

selectionContract.array: A=0x8312D7B0 holds candidate item words. At 0x82CECBA4..0x82CECBB4 the generator calls 0x82CB44E0(cityIndex,A,prefixCount,totalCount). At 0x82CECBB8 it saves returned r3 as ordinal r27; -1 skips assignment. Otherwise 0x82CECBC8..0x82CECBD0 loads A[ordinal] without a new local range comparison and distinguishes -12. The ordinary arm 0x82CECCA8..0x82CECCB8 calls 0x82CB42B8(cityIndex,ordinal,A,r24).
selectionContract.qualification: A valid ordinal selecting a preserved populated word 0 is required. A type ID is not the returned ordinal; global scratch contents, count, actual chooser result and preservation across earlier helpers and dispatch remain separate. Reuse the accepted mode 1 and mode-1 callers and closed direct-call censuses.

aiEvaluator.entry: 0x82CB44E0 is the accepted AIUnitChoiceEvaluate. Its result is an ordinal:0x82CB5528 reloads r16 from frame+0xA0,0x82CB5544 reads the selected item into r25 from fixed A indexed by r16, and 0x82CB6E30 copies r16 into r3 before the epilogue.
aiEvaluator.choice: The evaluator can extend the fixed candidate array with qualifying wonder IDs 200+slot at 0x82CB47C8..0x82CB482C. Score selection 0x82CB668C..0x82CB66A0 and random fallback 0x82CB54B8..0x82CB551C do not establish an actual chosen ordinal or a universal range or preservation contract.
aiEvaluator.directWriteDiscriminator: For preserved item 0, definition 0 byte+0x40 is 0: supported word 0x82F70118=0x00000200. At 0x82CB6754..0x82CB6764 the zero-byte and item!=28 tests branch to 0x82CB6A90. Thus this selected type 0 bypasses the intervening direct unit current-item substitution/CityUpdate branch; that branch needs a nonzero byte+0x40 or item 28. Live definition and selected-item preservation are required.
aiEvaluator.type0ReturnArm: At 0x82CB6A90 the selected type 0 enters a second player-mask, session and registry classifier; its nonnull-child calls 0x82CB6AE8/0x82CB6B08 and lookup 0x82CB6B20 remain required edges. If they return with state preserved, nonzero classifier at 0x82CB6B54 goes to 0x82CB6E30; the other arm also reaches that return because signed item 0<100 at 0x82CB6B5C. The five explicit direct city+0x38 halfword writers 0x82CB6864,0x82CB6930,0x82CB6A34,0x82CB6D08,0x82CB6DE8 are bypassed for this preserved type 0. This explicit-store bound does not exclude alias or callee effects.
aiEvaluator.qualification: Unexpanded required helper and session and registry dispatch calls can affect return, frame, array, selected item and city memory. The native return instruction is a local continuation, not proof of total normal return or that type 0 is selected.

ordinarySubmit.inputs: At 0x82CB42C4 the helper overwrites incoming r5 with cityIndex from r3. At 0x82CB42D8/0x82CB42E0 it reads the item from fixed A[ordinal], ignoring the incoming array pointer; 0x82CB42E4..0x82CB42E8 reads signed city owner into r4. Ordinary item 0 bypasses the -10,-13,-11,-12 special branches.
ordinarySubmit.alreadyCurrent: At 0x82CB44A0..0x82CB44B0 the ordinary branch compares selected item r7 with signed city+0x38 and branches directly to the epilogue when equal. A selected item 0 already current therefore sends no fresh type-five command on this local arm and does not locally clear or replace the current item.
ordinarySubmit.newItem: When different, 0x82CB44B8 calls 0x82D038E8(0). If it returns preserving r4=owner,r5=cityIndex,r7=item0 and the frame, 0x82CB44BC sets r6=0; 0x82CB44C4 sets r8=-1; 0x82CB44C8 sets type r3=5; 0x82CB44CC loads r7 from 0x82F7AD00; 0x82CB44D0 calls 0x82CE1950. The ordinary branch has no local population or Settler-definition test.
ordinarySubmit.continuation: After submit returns, 0x82CB44D4 calls 0x82CD58B8 before the epilogue. After the helper returns, the generator rereads A[ordinal] at 0x82CECCBC; -13 restarts, otherwise it returns preserved totalCount at 0x82CECCC8..0x82CECCD0. These continuations require normal returns and preserved ordinal, base, count, frame and array; no executed action follows from their presence.

humanSubmit.acceptedIngress: The accepted category 0 UI call 0x82E02D94 -> 0x82CEE650 supplies signed owner,cityIndex,selected+0x448 without category 0 conversion. For selected value 0, preserving those values reaches stack record(type5,owner,cityIndex,item0,[0x82F7AD00]) at 0x82CEE6BC..0x82CEE6D0.
humanSubmit.requiredBeforeRecord: The producer first invokes the actual vptr+0x80 target of receiver 0x8314F76C at 0x82CEE684, calls 0x82D038E8 at 0x82CEE68C, and conditionally calls 0x82D8A3A0 at 0x82CEE6B4. Their normal returns and preserved owner, city, item and frame are required. No local population or Settler eligibility recheck appears between producer entry and record construction.
humanSubmit.delivery: The local arm calls 0x82CE16C8 at 0x82CEE76C. The other arm constructs an object at 0x82CEE71C and conditionally calls actual manager child vptr+0x44 at 0x82CEE748. The selected actual route, dispatch effects and delivery are not proved.

recordAndAssignment.separateProducer: For incoming(type5,owner,cityIndex,item0,arg4,target-1), 0x82CE1950 saves those arguments and, after its guarded pre-record call returns with them preserved, stores(type,owner,cityIndex,item,arg4) to frame+0x50..+0x60 at 0x82CE19CC..0x82CE19DC. It locally drains at 0x82CE1AB0 or constructs at 0x82CE1A30 and conditionally calls actual child vptr+0x44 at 0x82CE1A64. The target!= -1 arm uses +0x3C at 0x82CE1A94. Routing, classifier and helper effects and actual delivery remain open.
recordAndAssignment.acceptedTransport: xbox-network-message-root defines the distinct 32-slot, 20-byte command ring and local-drain dispatcher call 0x82CE17B0 -> 0x82CDDF08; that closed queue and call evidence was reused without reopening its bodies.
recordAndAssignment.localWriter: The accepted type-five dispatcher loads record owner, city and item into r31/r15/r29. Its 0x82CDFFFC..0x82CE0010 owner check forms B+0xBC*cityIndex, B=0x8314FE28, and requires matching signed owner. At 0x82CE0018 it calls 0x82CB3F08(cityIndex), then 0x82CE0020 stores the low halfword of the value preserved in r29 to city+0x38. For item 0 this assigns Settlers 0 if that call normally returns preserving dispatcher state. No local item, population or candidate-list eligibility recheck precedes this store.
recordAndAssignment.helper: The inspected 0x82CB3F08 body returns a scalar, with several local early exits, and directly stores only to its own frame. Its current-item read 0x82CB40E8 can affect that scalar. The dispatcher does not test its returned r3 before the item store. Its internal 0x82D8A3A0/0x82CD5A70 calls and save and restore thunks remain unexpanded; no full return, memory-preservation or queue-reset contract is inferred.

existingCurrentProduction.independentRead: CityUpdate0x82D13978 saves incoming cityIndex and mode r4 at frame+0x174/+0x17C. Mode 1 branches from 0x82D13A50 directly to 0x82D159A4, which reads signed current item from city+0x38 without calling the candidate generator first. A preserved item 0 enters the accepted unit cost and population check independently of any new menu choice.
existingCurrentProduction.failureContinuation: Insufficient cost 0x82D159FC, failing population 0x82D15A80, and creation result -1 at 0x82D15ABC branch to 0x82D16388. At 0x82D16388..0x82D16390, preserved nonzero mode goes directly to the epilogue 0x82D16B98..0x82D16B9C, with no intervening local item clear, replacement, invested-production subtraction or other call before the restore thunk. For mode 1 this supplies a local arm, within the inspected scope, that preserves the current item and invested production, subject to valid frames, prior helper preservation and restore effects. No particular returned r3 value is claimed.
existingCurrentProduction.zeroModeBoundary: Zero mode instead enters the next phase and calls 0x82CF1060(cityIndex) at 0x82D163BC. Full city update, subsequent queue and item behavior, growth, save-load state and total normal return remain unresolved.
existingCurrentProduction.successBoundary: The separate preserved-success continuation can reach 0x82D15FC0..0x82D16120, reread the current item and conditionally call the generator at 0x82D160F8; its nonzero-mask, session and registry, notification, 0x82D11AD8 and creation-helper effects are not yet established. That continuation cannot be used as proof that a failed population check automatically replaces a queued Settler.

populationRequirementAssessment.supportedIdea: An unattainable comparison threshold is a possible future construction policy at the shared candidate and independent completion checks. The observed thresholds are encoded in code for definition flag+0x50 bit 1, not an identified per-unit minimum-population table field. All flag 1 definitions that pass the check share that logic, so changing the common constants is not established as applying to Settlers 0 only.
populationRequirementAssessment.requiredCoverage: Both threshold alternatives, both candidate and completion checks, type 0-specific scope, assignment and list bypasses, already-current item handling and AI fallback need coverage. Raising only candidate acceptance leaves a current item 0 entering completion; raising completion does not locally clear the item on the inspected failure-to-mode 1-exit arm.
populationRequirementAssessment.representation: Population is read as a signed byte; CityUpdate entry 0x82D139D4..0x82D139E4 clamps values>=32 to 31. This local clamp is not a universal maximum or a reward-helper proof. A future threshold must be represented as a comparison operand without wrapping the population byte or overlooking reduced-threshold arms. No number, patch or supported mod setting is selected.
populationRequirementAssessment.separateScopes: Starting units, existing Settler units, milestone and village grants, captured cities and broader one-city rules are separate. The shared creation helper 0x82D11750 must not be globally suppressed from this construction-only evidence.

currentEvidence.method: Serialized foreground read-only canonical-project DumpMemoryWords queries at radius0 supplied 4595 unique words. Each matched the supported flat image. Capstone 5.0.7 PPC64BE decoded 1606 generated instruction comments with checked aliases and 2925 native-only instructions; 63 words 0x82CB5728..0x82CB5820 are inline dispatch data rather than instructions; one word showed definition 0 byte+0x40. Exact own and next generated headers and precise spans and requests preceded each generated or derived-body read; native-only windows stayed below exact next numeric entries. No new caller census or closed producer scan ran.
currentEvidence.qualification: The observed title revision identifies checkout context. Generated artifacts are independently pinned by whole-file digests, not asserted tracked blobs or runtime identity. Static local continuations do not establish actual choice, delivery or execution, ABI preservation, full return or preserved live definitions, array, owner, city, frame and item. Native base checks do not establish the effective title UEA 45 value; preserve the earlier host-insertion qualification.

guards: Do not equate returned ordinal with item ID, an incoming ignored array pointer with the actual fixed array, or a command transport ring with a multi-item production queue.
Do not treat a local equality skip, ignored scalar return, absence of local eligibility checks or branch to an epilogue as full call, delivery, return or preservation proof.
Do not call temporary evaluator current-item substitutions a committed Settlers 0 assignment; preserve the selected type 0 definition-byte branch discriminator.
Do not treat a high population requirement, menu removal, shared creation-helper suppression or the local cap31 as an implemented human and AI OCC prohibition.
assignmentAndQueueBoundary.conclusion: A valid preserved ordinary selection of type 0 can submit a type-five item 0 record through distinct human and AI or general producers; owner-matched case five assigns the preserved low halfword to city+0x38 without a local population recheck. The ordinary helper skips resubmission when type 0 is already current. Existing item 0 independently reaches completion, and a failed population check can take the mode 1 epilogue arm without a local clear or replacement. A high requirement therefore needs separate candidate, completion and existing-item policy; complete choice, delivery, helper returns, queue handling and execution are not yet established.
assignmentAndQueueBoundary.nextDiscriminator: Before enforcing construction policy, establish the type 0 existing-item replacement or cancellation and invested-production policy across zero-mode 0x82D163BC -> 0x82CF1060 and the enclosing city-update continuation, including actual mode and preserved city, frame and item; keep it separate from 0x82D15AB0 -> 0x82D11750 creation and grant effects. For an ordered actual selection-to-store proof, establish the evaluator or chooser ordinal and fixed A word, required 0x82CB44B8 -> 0x82D038E8 preservation, selected transport route and target and 0x82CE0018 -> 0x82CB3F08 return and dispatcher preservation. Do not repeat closed call and store searches without a new discriminator.

populationRequirementBoundary.question: Which exact native comparison operands can express a Settlers 0-only above-cap population requirement in shared human and AI candidate filtering and ordinary completion, and what limits the subsequent AI fallback?

scope.boundary: Two exact generated bodies and native-only AI evaluator and city-update windows within the inspected scope were inspected. Neither native-only function has a following physical generated header; those generated bodies were not read. Accepted callers, command assignment and delivery, technology and UEA facts were reused without reopening their bodies or closed searches. The result is a native comparison-operand contract that still depends on conditions that are not established, and an AI-fallback negative within the inspected scope, not an insertion mechanism, policy publisher, patch, supported setting, total return or runtime enforcement.

candidateComparison.site: Immediately before 0x82CEC7A8, native cmpw cr6,r8,r11 compares signed32 population P in r8 with signed32 minimum T in r11. The following 0x82CEC7AC branches to 0x82CEC838 when P<T. It accepts P>=T.
candidateComparison.selector: Current candidate definition index is r30, initialized 0 at 0x82CEC65C and emitted at 0x82CEC828; r30.s32==0 selects Settlers 0. Here r28=148*r30 is the definition byte offset, r27 is the preserved live count, r29 the output pointer and r25 the total count. Neither a chooser ordinal nor the current production item is this candidate selector.
candidateComparison.population: Preserved city offset r14=188*i, base r23=0x8314FE28 and definition base r20=0x82F700D8 form the local inputs. At 0x82CEC79C..0x82CEC7A4, raw city+3 is loaded and sign-extended into r8. Its current representable range is -128..127.
candidateComparison.mergedThreshold: Native T=2 when cumulative UEA 45 returns nonzero or, with zero result, the owner-indexed word is 5; otherwise T=3. The alternatives merge at 0x82CEC79C. The proposed full-width operand must be supplied after those alternatives and before 0x82CEC7A8; changing only the default 3 can leave the reduced 2 arm active.
candidateComparison.rejectionAndLiveness: A rejected candidate reaches 0x82CEC838, increments r30 and continues the native enumeration and count test; it skips this append, count and pointer increments and successful-append live-count reload. Population success reloads r11 from definition flags at 0x82CEC7B0. On rejection the next iteration or later phase overwrites r11 before another use. The threshold is locally dead after its CR6 decision; no other added clobber is permitted by this fact.
candidateComparison.coveragePremise: Flag1 at definition+0x50 is tested at 0x82CEC750..0x82CEC758. A clear bit bypasses this comparison. Supported definition 0 flags=1, verified at 0x82F70128; preserving that bit and the actual type, city, index, frame and lookup state is required.
